sources.note: The current producer-owned shop identifies Wayna Cerveza Artesanal in Santiago del Estero, describes its Amber Ale and related own beer products, and publishes the phone and email; the reviewed products and packs were marked Out of stock, so no usable remote-order mechanism is claimed.
The live producer-owned site presents Wayna as a craft brewery in Santiago del Estero and publishes the same direct contact details and brewery/shop navigation.

The dated exhibitor guide independently identifies the brewery in Santiago del Estero, gives its Lomas del Golf address and lists its beer styles; it supports the unit historically but does not establish current stock or sales.
The producer-owned Alimentos La Banda site is live at review time and is the current public domain associated with Productora Santiagueña de Río Dulce and its La Banda brand.

The INTI/Argentina.gob.ar profile identifies Productora Santiagueña de Río Dulce S.A. as an industrial producer of canned vegetables and legumes in La Banda, describing its plant and own La Banda products.

The Universidad Nacional de Santiago del Estero reports a July 2025 visit to the Productora Santiagueña de Río Dulce factory in the Parque Industrial and describes its current food-industry canning and packaging processes.

The current producer site identifies Alcaparras Argentinas as producing, preparing and exporting capers, caper berries and other pickled vegetables in La Banda; it publishes Ruta 34 Nueva km 724.5, phone and email.
The Unión Industrial de Santiago del Estero directory identifies the agroindustry in Parque Industrial La Banda and corroborates its website, phone and email.
The provincial government reports Alfajores Santiagueños Nevados among the food-value producers exhibiting in La Banda in August 2025.
The current business listing identifies Alfajores Nevados at Omill (S) N° 16 in La Banda, publishes the phone and describes an area of production where artisanal alfajores are made.
El mapa oficial de Alimentos Argentinos identifica Ficcos Gourmet libre de gluten en La Banda, Santiago del Estero, como elaborador de panificados libres de gluten.
La guía de expositores 2025 identifica el obrador de Ficco's Gourmet en Magallanes 469, La Banda, y enumera alfajores de algarroba, uva y chocolate, rosquetes y donas.
La cobertura de Caminos y Sabores 2026 incluye Ficcos Gourmet entre los productores participantes; confirma actividad pública reciente, sin aportar una dirección nueva.

La nota de junio de 2026 identifica la Cooperativa Santiago de Producción Limitada bajo la marca Monte Vivo, describe su transformación de algarroba, mistol y chañar y la sitúa en el entorno productivo de La Banda.

La cobertura de abril de 2025 describe la planta propia de Monte Vivo en San Ramón, a pocos kilómetros de La Banda, y sus productos habilitados: harina de algarroba, café de algarroba, café de mistol y café de chañar.
La entrevista identifica a Monte Vivo como nombre comercial de Santiago en Producción, describe la fábrica habilitada y ubica la elaboración en San Ramón, departamento Banda, en calle Alegre.
